veto.summary: Launcher stop/finalise sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL to the run's process group, appends a run.end row, removes the pointer line and deletes the run file (keyword: destructive: truncated).
State-files module removes pointer lines and rmSync's the pointer file at zero kept lines; drops malformed lines (keyword: destructive: drops).
End-to-end verification runs live launch, stop and re-launch scenarios against the real dashboard and ledger (keyword: destructive: drops).
Harness page drops a stale log batch and replaces the buffer on reset; UI only, no persistent state (keyword: destructive: drops).
